name: diphenhydramine + zinc acetate
purpose: Active Ingredients Purpose Diphenhydramine HCL 2% Topical Analgesic Zinc Acetate 0.1% Skin Protectant
uses: Uses Temporary relieves pain and itching associated with: Insect Bites Minor Burns Minor Cuts Sunburn Minor Skin Irritations Scrapes Dries oozing and weeping of Poison Ivy, Poison Oak, and Poison Sumac Rashes due to Poison Ivy, Poison Oak, and Poison Sumac.
otcwarn: For external use only. Do not use on large areas of the body with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one taken by mouth. Ask doctor before use on chicken pox on measles Stop use and ask doctor if conditions worsen, or do not improve within 7 days symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days.
